id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3867: "Sob... why did you die? Leaving me behind... why...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3876: "...The day Yggdrasil fell to earth, my lover died. He'd been so healthy until then...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3883: "...Yes. Each leaf of Yggdrasil holds the life of someone in this world. My lover lost his life with Yggdrasil...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|389b: "...The day the world changed, monsters suddenly turned violent, and my lover died.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|38b2: "He was going to show me a phantom flower that blooms in Gallopolis's desert as a proposal gift... sob...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|38c1: "I don't want to live in this world anymore... Ah... but one regret: I want to see that phantom desert flower once.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|38d0: "Traveler... if you ever find the phantom flower in the Gallopolis region, would you show it to this pitiful woman?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|38ea: "Oh... sorry. I said something selfish. Yes, it must be a bother to you...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|38f3: "It's all right... I won't resent you. I'll quietly go to him alone...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3908: "Thank you... how kind you are. Then I'll tell you what I know about the phantom desert flower.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3923: "Maybe the rose blooms at night. I can't believe a rose blooms in the desert, but it's him, so it must be true.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3963: "Maybe the rose blooms at night. I can't believe a rose blooms in the desert, but it's him, so it must be true.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3930: "Please, traveler... Search the Gallopolis region at night, every corner, and show me the desert rose.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3971: "Please, traveler... Search the Gallopolis region at night, every corner, and show me the desert rose.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3946: "The phantom flower in Gallopolis's desert... I want to see the flower he meant as a proposal, just once.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3981: "Oh... it's you. What is it? Surely you haven't found the phantom desert flower...?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3998: "...Don't push yourself. If you died, someone who treasures you would surely grieve...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39b4: "Th-this is the phantom desert flower...?! A rose made of crystal, truly nature's art...!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39c2: "He wanted to show me this... Amazing... it feels like the power of life sprouting from the earth bloomed.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39d0: "...Strange. Looking at this flower, I almost hear his voice. Telling me not to come yet...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39dc: "Yes... maybe I can live a little longer. Thank you, traveler... thanks to you, I may do my best a little longer.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39e7: "It's not much... but take this as thanks. Use it on your journey.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39f7: "Looking at the desert rose, memories of happy times come back to me...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a0e: "Kind traveler... I pray your journey goes well.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a35: "Oh? Are you traveling with a girl? Take good care of her.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a4c: "Thank you very much. Come again when you feel like it.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a5c: "Thank you very much. Come again when you feel like it.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a6d: "You're a traveler too, aren't you? Those eyes full of curiosity and hope... like seeing myself when young.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a7a: "Adventure is great! A man's romance! While you're young, follow your curiosity and have all kinds of adventures!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a97: "Feeling this pleasant sea breeze, I recall my youth as an adventurer sailing the world.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3aa6: "I captained an exploration ship then, hunting treasure with my crew. And once I found a great one.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ab7: "A legendary treasure called the Sage's stone... I still can't forget the thrill of finding it in a mountain of treasure.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ac8: "But on the voyage home, a sudden storm hit. All the treasure was thrown into the sea.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ad7: "Greedy, I tried to dive in after it, but my crew talked me out of it and I gave up the treasure in tears.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3af5: "Say, traveler. Before I die, I want to see the Sage's stone just once more. Can you grant this old man's dream?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b0b: "Of course. Searching for treasure sunk on the seabed is like grasping at clouds. Forget this old man's ramblings.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b2d: "The storm hit my ship in the sea east of Heliodor. If the Sage's stone is anywhere, it's around there.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b6f: "The storm hit my ship in the sea east of Heliodor. If the Sage's stone is anywhere, it's around there.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b39: "But searching the seabed is nearly impossible. Unless ships could dive, you couldn't find it.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b7b: "But searching the seabed is nearly impossible. Unless ships could dive, you couldn't find it.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b49: "It's like grasping at clouds, but if you ever find the Sage's stone, show it to me. I entrust this old man's dream to you!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b8b: "It's like grasping at clouds, but if you ever find the Sage's stone, show it to me. I entrust this old man's dream to you!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b61: "Find the Sage's stone, the treasure sunk on the seabed, with your own hands and show it to me once more.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b9e: "Oh, you're back. Well? Did you find the Sage's stone?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ba8: "Well, of course. Searching for treasure sunk on the seabed is nearly impossible. It won't be found so easily. Ha ha!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bc4:
{var:1} showed the old man
the Sage's stone found
in the undersea kingdom!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bcd: "Ohh! T-that's the Sage's stone! Surely the treasure I once got! You really found it!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bdb: "...Hm? Not taking it? You found this treasure, didn't you? So it's yours.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3be7: "Besides, I realized something. The crew who weathered that storm with me... they are my greatest treasure!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bf3: "Right! For granting my dream despite the impossible request, I'll give you a fantastic reward!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c04: "The legendary treasure, the Sage's stone... It sparkled so brightly! Glad I saw it once more before I die.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c11: "Still, no matter the age, adventure is thrilling and fun. A man must keep chasing romance!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c37: "Believe it or not, I was a great singer as a child. They called me a prodigy and made a fuss over me.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c61: "Believe it or not, I was a great singer as a child. They called me a prodigy and made a fuss over me.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c44: "I'd ride the biggest ship in town and sing for the sailors. Such happy days.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c6e: "I'd ride the biggest ship in town and sing for the sailors. Such happy days.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cae: "I'd ride the biggest ship in town and sing for the sailors. Such happy days.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c51: "Sea creatures even popped up to hear my singing.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c7b: "A mermaid even popped out of the sea to hear my singing.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c83: "Don't believe me? Ask a mermaid. If you're lucky enough to meet one, that is. Ho ho ho.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ca1: "Believe it or not, I was a great singer as a child. They called me a prodigy and made a fuss over me.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cbb: "A mermaid even popped out of the sea to hear my singing. Don't believe me? Ask a mermaid.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cc8:
{var:1} told him that a mermaid
in the undersea kingdom wants
to hear his song.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cd2: "...Ho ho ho! That mermaid remembered my song! I couldn't be happier!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cdc: "I'd love to sing for her, but I've grown too old... I can't sing like before.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ce7: "Traveler, sorry to ask the impossible, but would you sing for that mermaid in my place?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cf6: "...Asking someone to sing out of nowhere is quite presumptuous.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d12: "Oh, bless you! Then remember the song I'm about to sing...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d1b: "The ship drifts free on the waves♪ The ocean racing through the wind is our home, our mother♪
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d26: "However far we part♪ If the sea song rides the breeze and reaches you♪ Our hearts return to the sea♪
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d33: "Ho ho ho, ho ho ho, ho-ho-hoo♪ Sing and dance the sea song♪ Echo and reach our mother♪
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d3e: "...Ho ho ho, can't do it like before. I leave the rest to you, traveler. Sing this song to the mermaid.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d53: "After leaving the ship and quitting song, I thought no one remembered my singing.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d76: "After leaving the ship and quitting song, I thought no one remembered my singing.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d5e: "I can't sing like before, but I was so happy to have someone hear my song again.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d68: "...Well, I leave the rest to you, traveler. Sing the song to the mermaid.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d81: "I can't sing like before, but I was so happy to have someone hear my song again.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d9b: "Lord Rotondo is renowned as the town's greatest merchant. I'm lucky to work under him.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3dae: "What? You're looking for a woman named Akia? That's me... Is there something?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3dbb: "Is that so? You looked like you had something to say. What an odd person.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ddc: "Oh, a letter from my brother Hakim! Thank you, mail carrier! I'll read it right away! Let's see...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3de7:
Hey, Akia, how are you?
Don't overdo patissier training.
You work so hard, I worry.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3df2:
Looking back, I've made you
suffer since you were little.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3df9:
We two siblings are finally free
of him. Now my dream is to see
you as a pâtissier.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e07:
I put some money in this letter
to help you live. Someday let your
big brother taste your cake!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e16: "...Oh, Brother. Preparing so much money must have been hard for you...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e20: "I'll write to my brother too. Could you wait a moment?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e28:
{var:1} waited for
Akia to write her letter.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e2e: "Mail carrier... sorry, but please give this letter to Brother Hakim at the west checkpoint of Gallopolis.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e3c:
{var:1} received
a letter from his sister!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e43: "And please don't tell Brother Hakim I quit being a pâtissier. When the time comes, I'll tell him myself.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e51: "Then I leave it to you, mail carrier with the clear eyes!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e7e: "Then I leave it to you, mail carrier with the clear eyes!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e61: "Sorry for the back and forth, but please deliver my letter to Brother Hakim at the west checkpoint of Gallopolis.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e71: "Please don't tell Brother Hakim that I quit being a pâtissier. When the time comes, I'll tell him myself.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e8a: "Oh, mail carrier, good day. Thank you so much for helping us siblings before.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e95: "I was so happy Brother sent a letter. Even far apart, we're connected... that's what family is.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ea9: "Today's special is fluffy, sweet cream puffs! Fresh from the oven and delicious!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f23: "Today's special is fluffy, sweet cream puffs! Fresh from the oven and delicious!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3eb5: "When you're worn out from working all day, nothing beats something sweet. What shall I eat today?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f30: "When you're worn out from working all day, nothing beats something sweet. What shall I eat today?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3eca: "...What? A letter from your brother? No, I'm not Akia. I'm Hera. Wrong person.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ed6: "Akia did work here as a pâtissier, but she quit a while ago.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3eff: "Akia did work here as a pâtissier, but she quit a while ago.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3edf: "She had great skill, a shame. I think she said she'd be a servant at Lord Rotondo's mansion next.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f08: "She had great skill, a shame. I think she said she'd be a servant at Lord Rotondo's mansion next.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3eeb: "She's probably busy near Lord Rotondo's mansion to the northeast. Say hello to Akia if you see her.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f14: "She's probably busy near Lord Rotondo's mansion to the northeast. Say hello to Akia if you see her.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f55: "Ah, mail carrier with the clear eyes. Perfect timing. I have a favor to ask.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f60: "Could you deliver this letter to an elderly gentleman named Seydon in Puerto Valor?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f73: "Well! Delivering is a mail carrier's job. What an odd person.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f8b: "Thank you, mail carrier! Here's the letter for Mr. Seydon.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f9a: "Puerto Valor, where Mr. Seydon lives, is northwest of this town by ship. Look for an elderly gentleman there.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3fc8: "Puerto Valor, where Mr. Seydon lives, is northwest of this town by ship. Look for an elderly gentleman there.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3fa9: "...I quit being a pâtissier and worked here all to hand that letter to Mr. Seydon...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3fd7: "...I quit being a pâtissier and worked here all to hand that letter to Mr. Seydon...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3fb4: "It's that important, so don't crumple it or lose it. Be sure to deliver it to Mr. Seydon!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3fe2: "It's that important, so don't crumple it or lose it. Be sure to deliver it to Mr. Seydon!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ff6: "Welcome back, mail carrier. You gave Mr. Seydon the letter. What was the doctor's reply?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4003: "...What?! He can't treat Father?! Why on earth?!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4009:
Give Akia the important letter
entrusted by Seydon?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4013: "Oh no... being mean at a time like this. What a cruel mail carrier!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4037: "...This isn't addressed to me. It's a letter addressed to Mr. Seydon. The sender is...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4046: "No... why would our father write to Dr. Seydon? Well, I'll read it...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4051:
Doctor... I heard on the wind that
my daughter Akia met you to heal
my leg.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|405d:
Doctor, if Akia ever spends money
on me, please give it back and
send it back to her.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4069:
And give her the check in this letter,
saying I told her to use it for
her dream of being a pâtissier.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4076:
That check is money I saved
by desperately tending horses after
learning she's chasing that dream.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4084:
I was a terrible father. I know
nothing I do now is forgivable.
I'm counting on you, Doctor.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4090: "So that's how it was... Father knew everything. I thought he'd forgotten me.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|409c: "Foolish Father... Because of you I gave up on my pâtissier dream, and now I want to chase it again...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40a7: "I thought our family fell apart, but we were connected by our thoughts. Why did we take such a roundabout way...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40b3: "Mail carrier... the letters you delivered united our hearts. Thank you. Please take this as thanks.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40cc: "Just as I gave up my pâtissier dream to save for Father's leg treatment...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40d7: "Father kept working desperately on his injured leg to support my dream.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40e4: "It took a long detour, but now the three of us can live happily as a family.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40f1: "First I'll use the money I saved to heal Father's leg and make him healthy!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4116: "Akia said she had something important to tell me, so I came, but...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|411e: "I heard everything from Akia. About Father's leg treatment... and that she gave up her pâtissier dream for it!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|412b: "Why must Akia sacrifice for Father, who ignored us and never sent a single letter...!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4141: "I heard Father's letter too. To think he saved money for Akia...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|414d: "But I won't forgive Father. Akia is my only family. Then and now.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|415e: "I suppose next year I'll go to Gallopolis to watch the Faris Cup and see Father's sour horse face.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a24:
I won't give up
on living

I wonder if the

tm.「ううっ……どうして 死んでしまったの。\n 私を残して……どうして……。: "Sob... why did you die? Leaving me behind... why...
